record.label: Fresh analytic hierarchy: Gaussian to Hermite/Mehler
record.summary: The one-use mini100 comparison is complete. Hermite order 4 is the best pure analytic baseline at layer-16 raw MSE 3.8493004e-6 and all-layer MSE 2.1180294e-6. Orders 4, 6, and 10 are effectively tied, so additional univariate Hermite order is not the remaining bottleneck. The first-layer prediction matches the exact Gaussian/ReLU formula to 2.94e-16 MSE, and its 6.88e-10 scored residual matches the reference Monte Carlo noise floor. CP1792 remains below 1e-7 through layer 2 and first crosses at layer 3.
record.terminal_criterion: Under one frozen mini split and the official meter, record per-layer and layer-16 raw MSE for diagonal Gaussian and Hermite/Mehler order 2, with target-blind predictions and no fitted correction.
